sections.heading: Planning your Narra Residences interior
sections.text:
Dairy Farm Walk is a green, hilly edge of District 23, and The Botany at Dairy Farm is listed on the same road. Owners in this belt usually want a home that can take family life without fighting the landscape: storage for daily clutter, window treatments planned after you have seen the actual facing, and bedrooms that are properly fitted rather than left with a bed and a loose rack. The carpentry that typically does that work is an entry shoe cabinet, a living-room joinery wall, full-height wardrobes, and a fitted kitchen with a tall pantry. Where a common bedroom will also be a study, a built-in desk and wardrobe on one wall is cleaner than a loose table. Maison is an interior designer; we specify built-in carpentry, not flat-pack furniture, and we are as comfortable producing a close shot of a wardrobe or a kitchen run as a wide living-room view.

We have no official floor plan on file, so this page does not list typologies or room sizes, and we will not reconstruct a layout from marketing language. Check your approved plan for the real kitchen position, the air-conditioning ledges and the window line before any cabinet is drawn. Views towards the hill or the estate landscaping are not guaranteed from every stack.

Until a key date is in writing, the useful work is design, not demolition. When keys arrive, inspect defects, measure, and obtain management renovation approval before fabrication. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals — an editorial allowance, not a guarantee. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan. We are not affiliated with the developer.
